name: Mordovia (Russia, 1995–2008)
description: Three horizontal stripes of red, white and blue in the ratio 1:2:1, with a dark red eight-pointed Mordvin solar sign in the centre.
history: The first flag of the Republic of Mordovia, adopted on 30 March 1995 with a broad white central stripe. In 2008 the proportions of the stripes were changed to equal thirds, producing the present flag.
